quote: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the right lane to turn right.

activation.condition: The operator intends to exit a roundabout by turning right.

obligation.description: Use the right lane to turn right.

timing.description: Lane use is assessed while circulating toward the intended exit.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original requested right-turn intent and actual first exit must be reviewed together.
Lane body occupancy and exit branch require original map and motion.
